responsibility: Implements the S/390 target’s gcc-driver side support for -march=native and -mtune=native. It runs on the host, parses /proc/cpuinfo to identify the local System z processor generation and facility bits such as DFP, HTM, vector, and high-GPR support, and returns the replacement command-line fragment used by the driver spec parser, including architecture/tuning names and corrective options like -mno-htm, -mno-vx, or -mzarch when appropriate.
